name: Octus
description: Access Octus' verified credit intelligence directly in Claude and other LLMs. The Octus MCP Connector™ delivers proprietary intel, issuer fundamentals, private data room documents and covenant analysis across 95%+ of the sub-investment grade credit universe. Query permissioned content in real time using natural language, power autonomous agent workflows and ground your AI systems in a trusted, standardized data source. Built for investment managers, banks, law firms and advisors who need research-grade answers at the speed of the market.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Octus to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Octus to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.octus.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Octus MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Octus lists 19 MCP tools, including describe_tool, find_company, get_company_details, get_deal_term_analytics_data, get_deal_term_analytics_deals, get_fundamentals_reported_data, get_fundamentals_standard_data, list_available_tools, list_companies, search_court_filings, search_covenants_private, and search_covenants_public.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Octus?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Octus in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Octus requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Octus is developed by Octus. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
